text:
ana: seeing a small spike in 504s from eu-west1 inference pool since ~09:10 UTC. likely regression from recent cache alloc tweak in v3.2.1. proposing minimal hotfix image registry.redwood/inference:v3.2.1-pin. requesting expedited canary + rollforward if green.
ben: share a short log sample + rollback plan pls. also propose canary size/window.
ana: logs:
```
2026-04-02T09:11:02Z inference-7 error: kv_cache_alloc > cap -> reclaim -> timeout 504
2026-04-02T09:11:03Z inference-7 warn: connection closed by upstream
```
image: registry.redwood/inference:v3.2.1-pin
rollback: pin back to v3.2.0, cordon & drain new nodes, redeploy previous image; runbook section "hotfix-rollback" (RB-510).
charlie: suggest tiny canary: 2 pods in eu-west1, 15m observation, ramp to 50% for 10m then full. disable autoscaler on canaries and set mem limit to 7Gi.
qa-bot: CI smoke + basic e2e passed for image registry.redwood/inference:v3.2.1-pin. preflight script included.
ben: +1 SRE, approve canary. I'll monitor p95/p99 and 5xx.
oncall-bot: @ana assigned to oncall until 2026-04-02T13:00Z. Hooks enabled: high-5xx-rate, p99-latency, node-memory.
deploybot: Deploy requested by ana -> eu-west1 canary (2 pods) image registry.redwood/inference:v3.2.1-pin. Observing 15m.
(deploybot) 09:22 UTC: canary 2/2 ready, healthchecks OK, 5xx trending down.
charlie: running mem probe every 2m, no OOM signals so far.
ben: 15m done, canary stable. authorizing ramp to 50% for 10m.
deploybot: ramping to 50% in eu-west1; monitoring.
09:35 UTC - deploybot: 10m observation complete. metrics: 5xx down ~85% from peak, latency stable.
ana: proceeding to full rollout in eu-west1 with a 10m final watch. release note draft: "v3.2.1-pin: revert cache alloc bump causing intermittent 504s in EU. No API change."
ben: final +1. charlie on standby for rollback.
deploybot: Full rollout complete for eu-west1. image: registry.redwood/inference:v3.2.1-pin. No alerts during watches.
qa-bot: post-rollout smoke ok.
ana: opening RB-510 follow-up to add integration tests for prefix-cache allocations and CI gating. marking thread resolved after changelog entry.
charlie: changelog updated. resolving. :white_check_mark:
